record.paper_title: Stability of Homomorphisms, Coverings and Cocycles II: Examples, Applications and Open Problems
record.original_question: Does the metric quotient U(n)/Sym(n), where U(n) carries the relevant unitary metric and Sym(n) is embedded as permutation matrices, satisfy a Poincare-type inequality with constants independent of n?

evidence.quote: it would be useful to have a Poincare-type inequality (cf. Lemma 5.4 in [CL23]) on the metric space U(n)/Sym(n), with constants independent of n.
But, the case of U(n)/Sym(n) seems to be open, and will be sufficient for us to translate the results of [JNV+22] to the permutation setup.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $U(n)$ denote the group of $n \times n$ complex unitary matrices equipped with the bi-invariant metric induced by the normalized Hilbert–Schmidt norm $\|A\|_{\mathrm{HS}}^2 = \frac{1}{n}\mathrm{tr}(A^*A)$. Let $\mathrm{Sym}(n) \hookrightarrow U(n)$ denote the symmetric group embedded as the group of $n\times n$ permutation matrices, acting on $U(n)$ by (say) left multiplication. Consider the metric quotient space $X_n := U(n)/\mathrm{Sym}(n)$ with the quotient metric, and equip $X_n$ with the pushforward of the Haar probability measure $\mu_n$ on $U(n)$.

Question: Does there exist an absolute constant $C > 0$, independent of $n$, such that for every $n \geq 1$ and every sufficiently regular (e.g.\ Lipschitz) function $f : X_n \to \mathbb{R}$, the Poincaré-type inequality
$$\mathrm{Var}_{\mu_n}(f) \;\leq\; C \int_{X_n} |\nabla f|^2 \, d\mu_n$$
holds, where $|\nabla f|$ denotes the metric (Lipschitz) gradient on $X_n$?

Equivalently, does $U(n)/\mathrm{Sym}(n)$ satisfy a Poincaré-type inequality with constants independent of $n$?
artifact.category_tag: Poincaré inequalities on metric quotients of unitary groups
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not turn up any work establishing (or disproving) a dimension-free Poincaré inequality on the metric quotient $U(n)/\mathrm{Sym}(n)$. The question is explicitly identified as open in the context where it arises (stability of homomorphisms, in connection with translating MIP*=RE-type results to the permutation setting), and no subsequent resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Matrix Poincaré inequalities and concentration
status_evidence.snippet: General framework for matrix Poincaré inequalities and concentration, but does not address U(n)/Sym(n).
status_evidence.claim: No treatment of the specific quotient U(n)/Sym(n) is found in standard matrix Poincaré literature.

status_evidence.title: Poincaré inequality - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Standard reference; no entry on quotient spaces U(n)/Sym(n).
status_evidence.claim: Standard references on Poincaré inequalities do not include this quotient case.
